Hold JUMP + grip: jump / continuous lift
Touch default: right A = JUMP
Other bindings: use mapped Jump button
Left stick X: steering / yaw (Y unused)
AUTO: thrusters keep pitch / roll level
MANUAL: wrist tilt = pitch / roll
Release grip before panel Interact

Release Space: lift off, then descend
AUTO: thrusters keep pitch / roll level
GROUND + AUTO: W/S drive / brake

Ctrl forward thrust / Shift brake
After takeoff: release W/S, A/D, Q/E

PgUp/PgDn view / Home default
